category_title: Gifted student with impulse control disorder and depression exhibiting perfectionism and anger fits
minimal_context: The student is standing outside the door, being asked to transition from group play to an individual work session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for us to work individually in the office now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to. I want to join my friends to play the games.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to do our work first. Please come inside.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands outside the door, looking reluctant to work) But they are playing games right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We can't wait. You need to come inside the room.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away, refusing to enter and standing outside the door) No! I am not coming in, I want to play with my friends!
